title: I built a Self-Learning AI Trading Bot for crypto and forex that gets smarter after every trade and learns to trade by itself
author: IshigamiSenku04
selftext:
I have trained one ML model on 10 years data of markets and the other one is Autonomous agent created by me using deepseek api. This is the data of 1 week of backtesting on live market with paper money, from today i am going to use them on real account and update the [website](https://crypto.winterwalls.com/) you can check it out!

# How It Works:

1. **🏆 When it Wins (Take-Profit Hit)**:
   * The AI reviews the winning trade, figures out *why* it worked, and saves the setup as a **"Winning Playbook"** so it can repeat it.
2. **🛑 When it Loses (Stop-Loss Hit)**:
   * The AI figures out what went wrong and writes a **"Never Do This Again" Rule** (Anti-Pattern) so it never repeats that mistake.
3. **🔄 Real-Time Memory**:
   * Before taking any new trade, the bot checks its memory database. If a setup looks like a past mistake, it skips it. If it looks like a proven winner, it takes the trade with high confidence.
4. **🛡️ Built-in Protections**:
   * Automatically stops trading during major high-impact news (like CPI / Fed interest rate announcements).
   * Automatically takes 50% profit at TP1 and moves the Stop Loss to Breakeven so winning trades never turn into losses.

It runs 24/7 on **Crypto (BTC, ETH, SOL)** and **Forex/Gold (EURUSD, XAUUSD)** and sends live entry, exit, and post-mortem alerts directly to Telegram.
